build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places two jars with balls and sloped ground
define_task_template: use the define_task_template decorator to register a parameterized task with up to 100 variations
add_scene_objects: add static bars, static jars, and dynamic balls to the PHYRE scene using C.add
update_task_goal: call C.update_task to set two ball bodies and a TOUCHING spatial relationship as the goal
set_solution_tier: call C.set_meta with SolutionTier.TWO_BALLS to mark the task as requiring two ball interactions
